observations: Two identical photos showing four game consoles standing vertically.
The consoles feature a horizontal slit across the side panels, which is the signature design of the PS5 Slim.
A disc drive bulge is visible on the side of the units, indicating they are the disc-version models.
The background shows a retail or repair shop with various electronics boxes.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI RICHARD IHEYI' is present across both images.
No controllers, cables, or specific unit details (like serial numbers) are shown.

The split-plate chassis design seen in photo 0 is unique to the Slim model.
Storage capacity is a system specification that requires a screenshot of the settings menu to confirm.
